To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a ratio of energy correlations is sensitive to the colour flow of an underlying hard event, that this ratio can be calculated perturbatively, that this ratio is infrared stable, that it can be measured at LEP, and that the result will be a new test of QCD.

a ratio of multiplicity correlations is sensitive to colour flows, that the ratio is infrared stable, that the ratio can be calculated completely in perturbation theory, and that the method can be used for any hard process.

the colour structure of the underlying process can be extracted from multiplicity correlations, that the colour flow in a hard process can be measured without any event selection, and that the colour flow is not sensitive to the details of the underlying event.
